messages.text: The Lantern Festival begins at 19:00 UTC in Amber Square.
Volunteers placed 40 lanterns around Amber Square.
Pax will open the east entrance.
Bring empty jars to the return table.

main_story.headline: Amber Square Prepares for Annual Lantern Festival
main_story.lede: Residents coordinated logistical arrangements for the upcoming Lantern Festival as final preparations took place in Amber Square.
main_story.body: The regional community turned its attention toward the *Lantern Festival*, scheduled to commence at 19:00 UTC. Organizing efforts focused on site readiness, with **Oren** confirming that 40 lanterns have been successfully positioned throughout the square to facilitate the evening event. Traffic management protocols for the square were also established. **Nora** announced that the east entrance will be managed by **Pax**, while the west entrance is designated to remain closed for the duration of the proceedings. Attendees are encouraged to utilize the return table for any empty jars brought to the celebration to assist with post-event site maintenance.
